$meta.title: σ-essential contextual state — solution-attempt taxonomy
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of every recorded approach to the OML-descent / σ-essential / σ-point-selection problem. Load this first for the 50,000-ft shape; follow `detail` pointers to drill into individual attempts.
$meta.problem_one_line: Does a concrete σ-complete non-Boolean irreducible OML carry a 2-valued state on a finite ⊥-closed subposet that extends to NO global σ-additive 2-valued state? (≡ σ-point-selection, the localized core.)
$meta.status: OPEN, but the LITERATURE FRONTIER IS NOW CLOSED (2026-06-27): every candidate field swept NEGATIVE (borrowable-principle hunt; RDP-impossibility (c)-open, gap not theorem; Harding/Hamhalter confirm open; DST corner + the CBER→concrete-logic bridge — the last flagged lead — KILLED §3j as a type/strength non-sequitur). Strength UNKNOWN (LB mechanism refuted §3f, UB unearned). Frontier: non-Polish / non-standard-Borel / irreducibly-non-central. NO ENTERING TOOL in any surveyed field — the convergence IS the finding. Resolution needs a genuinely NEW object built from scratch, not transported.
$meta.the_shape: Almost every construction route bottoms out at ONE wall: the disjointification identity (a∨b)∧a⊥=b∧a⊥ (distributive, false on OMLs). Carriers die because they are segregated/finite/Boolean-enough; abstract routes recur as 'costumes' of disjointification. Genuine non-costume content: the localization reduction, the Polish upper boundary (DW), the Blecher–Weaver Hilbert precedent (does not transfer), and the two unproven large-cardinal bounds. UPDATE 2026-06-27: the literature frontier is now mapped CLOSED -- no field supplies a borrowable principle (every candidate is Boolean / real-valued / Polish), the RDP-failure obstruction is NOT a theorem (gap, not impossibility), and Ψ's consistency strength is genuinely UNKNOWN (the measurable conjecture was refuted, not just unproven). The witness, if it exists, is a genuinely new non-Polish object; the one structural rhyme is the Glimm-Effros 'non-smooth <=> no 2-valued section' dichotomy (a bridge to BUILD, unpublished).

categories.candidate_carrier: a concrete σ-OML tried as the witness-carrier
categories.strategy: a route/reduction seeking (or bounding) a witness
categories.costume: a framing that reduces to the disjointification wall — a re-dress, not new
categories.wall: a load-bearing structural obstruction (a bound, not an attempt)
categories.fenced_reversal: a tempting wrong inference, caught and explicitly forbidden to re-derive
categories.open_frontier: a genuinely open sub-question or unbuilt target
categories.gate: a PRE-REGISTERED conditional consequence: an investigation × enumerated outcomes → claimed effect on another id. Committed BEFORE the result (pending), then a branch fires (dated). RECORD-ONLY — the consequent's status is still set by its own verified entry, never auto-derived from the gate. Distinct from kills_or_bounds (unconditional, post-hoc).

key_links.costume_of: id of the wall/death this is a re-dress of
key_links.kills_or_bounds: ids this wall/fact rules out or constrains
key_links.investigation: the probe/result whose outcome the gate is keyed on
key_links.outcomes: enumerated possible outcomes, each {branch, then} — pre-registered
key_links.affects: {id, effect} — the consequent node + the claimed consequence (record, not auto-applied)

$meta.lean_certificates: Entries with a `lean` field have a Lean certificate (file+name+status). Statuses: proved-edge (a proved logical relationship), open-prop (named open conjecture, not assumed), detector (the costume-detector obstruction), detector-rekill (a covered item re-killed by the detector), conjecture-survives-triage (passed the stress-test, gap=wall A), cited-axiom. Receipts via `#print axioms`.

walls.name: Disjointification identity
walls.one_line: (a∨b)∧a⊥=b∧a⊥ is distributive, FALSE on OMLs; blocks transfer of state-agreement from joins to meets. The recurring bottleneck.

walls.name: σ-point-selection (Wall A)
walls.one_line: THE core. Does a finitely-coherent local 2-valued pattern extend to a global NON-Dirac σ-additive 2-valued state on a concrete non-Boolean σ-OML?

walls.name: Floor / faithful σ-tribe
walls.one_line: A faithful tribe-of-sets representation forces distributivity ⟹ Boolean. Faithfulness ⊥ non-distributivity at root.

walls.name: Tribe-vs-points gap
walls.one_line: Every non-Boolean σ-LS image is σ-epimorphic, NOT separating 2-valued points; needs RDP, OMLs lack it (MO₂ witness).

walls.name: Derr–Williamson Polish cut
walls.one_line: σ-essential cell EMPTY for Polish-representable carriers (DW Thm D.6 via Maharam 8.1). Upper boundary: a witness must be non-Polish-representable.

walls.name: Harding–Wang Problem 2
walls.one_line: Does every OMP embed into SOME σ-complete OMP? Open in literature; resolved ORTHOGONAL to Wall A (type mismatch — A's carrier already σ-complete), dropped as red herring.

walls.name: No σ-Loomis–Sikorski for OMLs
walls.one_line: Where the Boolean resolution mechanism would have to live — absent for non-distributive OMLs. Suggested impossible, not proved.

candidate_carriers.name: ∏ₙMO₂
candidate_carriers.one_line: Reducible + σ-additivity concentrates to points + segregated ⟹ Dirac-only. THE standing unit test; contextuality lives on central P(ℕ), not the lattice.

candidate_carriers.name: Greechie growing-girth tower
candidate_carriers.one_line: Contextuality is parity-based (Svozil), only finitely-additive, no σ-threshold.

candidate_carriers.name: Linear ℤ-chain
candidate_carriers.one_line: Loop-free ⟹ full 2-valued states (SvTk 3.10) ⟹ df-states span ⟹ non-contextual.

candidate_carriers.name: Horizontal sum ω₁·P(ℕ)
candidate_carriers.one_line: Meet only at {0,1} ⟹ no binding ⟹ diagonal coupling ⟹ no forced leak. add(𝒩) was a red herring.

candidate_carriers.name: MO_{ω₁} (Chinese lantern)
candidate_carriers.one_line: Uncountable blocks ✓ but finite (4-element) ✗ ⟹ S_df^σ = S_df, no fakes.

candidate_carriers.name: Navara-over-concrete-base
candidate_carriers.one_line: Statelessness vs concreteness fight at the atom — structural incompatibility.

candidate_carriers.name: MO_ω / finite-block families
candidate_carriers.one_line: Finite blocks ⟹ S_df = S_df^σ. The 4 necessary conditions are necessary, not sufficient.

candidate_carriers.name: Tkadlec covering route
candidate_carriers.one_line: Boolean-forcing covering theorems never trigger; σ-completion preserves the gap.

candidate_carriers.name: Harding two-chain lever
candidate_carriers.one_line: Config needs countable chains ⟹ block-local ⟹ countable blocks ⟹ caught by the countable-block theorem.

candidate_carriers.name: L_MO₂ (Navara hsum, MO₂-swap)
candidate_carriers.one_line: Real descent structure YES but trivial (= plain ∏ₙMO₂) + prior art (Pták–Pulmannová 1994: Boolean ⟺ subadditive). First escape attempt from ∏ₙMO₂.

candidate_carriers.name: Band family (AD-indexed, 𝔠 blocks)
candidate_carriers.one_line: Sharp dichotomy: ∪-closed ⟹ Boolean / not-∪-closed ⟹ not-a-lattice. NO band index gives a concrete σ-complete non-Boolean lattice. Lean-certified (BandClosure.lean, 0-sorry).

candidate_carriers.name: CE-charge-limit carrier (S9)
candidate_carriers.one_line: Limit-failure IS non-σ-additivity ⟹ ∏ₙMO₂ death in new clothes.

candidate_carriers.name: DST analytic-not-Borel S_df^σ (S10)
candidate_carriers.one_line: Reduces to σ-lifting-failure (the wall, not a witness). DST bypass fails: the restriction-gap is structural, not topological.

strategies.name: Localization reduction
strategies.one_line: Witness ⟺ (i) no Dirac extends s₀ ∧ (ii) no non-Dirac σ-state does; (i) freely arrangeable (Navara–Pták), so all weight on (ii) = Wall A. The one genuine reduction.

strategies.name: Navara–Pták template (ℚ², B∩C∩D=∅)
strategies.one_line: Defeats Diracs but N–P BUILD their own non-Dirac σ-state rescuer ⟹ not a witness; supplies clause (i) only. Carrier Boolean-enough (two compatible observables).

strategies.name: Blecher–Weaver Hilbert transfer
strategies.one_line: Tried to import B–W (pure σ-state on B(ℓ²κ) ⟺ κ Ulam-measurable) to concrete sector. Fails: wrong carrier (Kochen–Specker, non-concrete), masa transfer fails (Akemann–Weaver), the consumed ultrafilter is structurally absent.

strategies.name: Lower bound: Ψ ⟹ ∃ measurable
strategies.one_line: MECHANISM REFUTED 2026-06-26 (bounds 3f): 'no measurable => every sigma-state Dirac => not-Psi' is BROKEN -- premise false (Navara-Ptak ZFC builds a non-Dirac sigma-state on a concrete non-Boolean sigma-class), and the last step is a non-sequitur (Dirac-only makes clause (ii) vacuous, pushing toward Psi). With UB already unearned, measurable-strength is unsupported in BOTH directions: Psi's strength is GENUINELY UNKNOWN, not conjecturally-measurable. GUARD: N-P is not a witness (Polish, DW-rescued), so this is 'mechanism broken + strength reopened', NOT 'Psi needs no large cardinal'.

strategies.name: Upper bound: ∃X ⟹ Ψ
strategies.one_line: SHARPENED 2026-06-26 to ONE open step: direct large-cardinal construction (Blecher-Weaver model) reduces to the masa-free U->non-Boolean transport -- is there a masa-free construction of a non-distributive concrete sigma-OML from a measurable cardinal's ultrafilter U, or a proof none exists? Forcing barred (Levy-Solovay); hand-construction barred where Polish (DW). ATTEMPTING (not hand-off). See rem:consharp + bounds 3e.

strategies.name: Strategy D / Clop(Y,𝔗)
strategies.one_line: Clop(Y,𝔗) not σ-complete (gap family) is TRUE but clears no contribution bar — Gaifman 1964 inhabits the ZFC cell stronger. Private name, never field-open. RHYME with the descent residue, not transfer.

strategies.name: Boolean-factoring (Type-5 impossibility)
strategies.one_line: Thesis 'σ-state strength always factors through a Boolean sub-object' FALSE for pure/2-valued (Akemann–Weaver: pure state on no masa). Tautology + evidence inverts.

strategies.name: Forcing programme (prove Ψ independent)
strategies.one_line: PARKED AS PREMATURE, not failed. Reduces upstream to Wall A, an open OBJECT-level math question; forcing settles independence of a sentence, can't force past unsolved math. No forcing-ready fixed carrier exists.

Takeuti–Zaring Ch.23 (class-sized Boolean algebras / Easton) read to beat unbounded cardinality. Does NOT unblock: every Ch.23 theorem PRESERVES strength (Ch.24 Easton = equiconsistent with ZFC, kills no measurables) — cardinality ≠ consistency strength (orthogonal axes); still forcing ⟹ still wrong engine (Lévy–Solovay); B is Boolean either way. Legitimate class-forcing BACKGROUND, not new input.

Route the σ-state obstruction through the OML's Boolean CENTER C(L), where a measurable/U applies natively (center is ∩-closed, no disjointification wall) — partner ce.concept.oml_center / Pták 1987 exotic logics. KILLED on TWO horns (NOT the Gleason horn, which is FALSE — MO₂ is irreducible/trivial-center yet the SOURCE of disjointification, does not force σ-additivity; that horn was advisor-pending and is now retired as wrong+ superfluous): trivial center = no HOST for U; non-trivial center = SEGREGATED (rem:segregated), σ-states concentrate at points, no witness. No inhabited middle.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: π–λ / state-agreement transfer to meets
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: OMLs can't propagate state-agreement from joins to meets; the identity fails. The mechanism, stated directly.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: Floor / faithful-σ-tribe
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: Faithful Loomis–Sikorski tribe forces distributivity ⟹ Boolean. (Also wall.floor.)

costumes_of_disjointification.name: Catuṣkoṭi dissolution
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: Tried to dissolve as metatheory-vs-object-logic confusion; FALSE — B–W IS forcing on a non-distributive OML.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: 7-route convergence
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: STRUCK. Honest count = 1 reduction + 3 angles on the same clause-(ii) object + failed dissolutions. A bottleneck, not a convergence.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: No-routing-port THEOREM
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: DEMOTED to a remark — no theorem-shaped meaning without a fixed reduction calculus. Content = 'clause (ii) is open' (literature-established).

costumes_of_disjointification.name: H¹ / cohomological obstruction
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: 5th costume. Re-derives Abramsky–Brandenburger σ-additive sheaf-contextuality (2022), a decade-old fact; generated at non-progress.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: Countable-carrier collapse
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: 4th costume. ¬Ψ via 'countable ⟹ no rescuer' shows 'orthogonally-refinable ⟹ no rescuer' = the distributivity axis, NOT cardinality.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: Selection-first reframe
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: 6th costume. 'Build the selection first, check lattice-admissibility after' — coherence conditions ARE closure conditions (BandClosure.lean); selection dies the same collapse.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: Embedding-transport of a measurable
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: 8th costume, FLAGGED-AVOIDED (not made). 'Use the inner-model embedding j to transport a κ-complete ultrafilter onto orthogonal-only closure' — both walls bottom out at the same identity.

costumes_of_disjointification.name: CBER non-smoothness → concrete-logic (Glimm–Effros transport)
costumes_of_disjointification.one_line: Non-hyperfinite-CBER non-smoothness transported onto a Gudder concrete logic = the last flagged constructive lead. KILLED: type/strength non-sequitur (=§3f mirror) — non-smoothness is a ZFC theorem + 'no Borel selector' (DEFINABILITY, AC-transversals exist), while clause (ii) is ABSOLUTE non-existence ≥ measurable. Definability obstruction can't deliver an existence obstruction. E∞ falls identically (kill is type/strength, not hyperfiniteness). Negative now COMPLETE; no entering tool.

fenced_reversals.one_line: 'G_δ ⟹ no leak' as causal — conullity is per-block-null + countable, not topological.
'RESOLVED ⟺ measurable cardinal' — fakes (non-σ free ultrafilters) ≠ Ulam/B–W σ-additive-off-atom states; on ℕ a clean ZFC contradiction.
'Strategy D = same object' — it's Boolean-distributive; OML leak needs non-distributivity. RHYME not transfer.
'ℕ-countable ⟹ Exit B / lines converge' — |Ω| countable ⇏ |L| countable (Müller).
'add(𝒩) ⟹ ZFC-independence' — not earned; add(𝒩) is a fixed-measure invariant.
'tower-LP feasible ⟹ Exit B' — circular; LP operates on S_df, never S_df^σ.
'single non-atomic block suffices' — a non-atomic block is Boolean ⟹ reducible + distributive.
Band-family reversals (#21 round-0-vs-σ-closure circularity; 'collapse finite-specific'; 'band dead ⟹ Exit B').
'couldn't-build ⟹ needs-choice ⟹ independent' — have step 1, suspect 2, have NOT shown 3.
'set-theoretic strength always factors through a Boolean/abelian sub-object' — FALSE for pure/2-valued (Akemann–Weaver).

'Class forcing transcends set-cardinality, so it can supply what Ψ needs.' FORBIDDEN: Ψ's two obstacles are (I) consistency strength + (II) non-distributivity; cardinality was NEVER one. Ch.23 buys cardinality, Ψ needs strength — orthogonal. Easton (Ch.24) is the proof: equiconsistent, creates no large cardinals.

'Answer-type is most likely INDEPENDENCE' (precedent-match on vN–Maharam / real-valued-measurable). FORBIDDEN: ranking is FLAT. (1) those precedents are two incompatible kinds (forcing-independence vs consistency-strength); (2) the one structural hook (Boolean-shadow ⟹ ≥measurable ⟹ not-ZFC-provable) is what §3f REFUTED; (3) 'resisted construction ⟹ independent' is definability-vs-existence on the modal axis — evidence about methods, symmetric (Ψ equally not refuted). Revives iff a §3f-surviving lower bound (large cardinal ⟸ Ψ) is re-proved.

settled_facts.one_line: S_df (all 2-valued states) is weak-* compact (closed in {0,1}^L); a σ-additive μ on S_df always exists. Question = is μ supported on non-compact S_df^σ.
Off-hull is finitely witnessed (Hahn–Banach in ℝ^L). Deliverable = the restriction-gap, NOT non-Borel S_df^σ (a topological shadow).
≤ℵ₀ atomic blocks ⟹ μ(fakes)=0 ⟹ no leak. A witness needs uncountably many INFINITE atomic blocks.

Incompatibility mechanisms fail oppositely: share-one-atom⟹finite blocks; share-{0,1}⟹trivial joins; share-nothing-infinite⟹finite blocks. Witness needs cross-block incompatible-not-orthogonal between INFINITE blocks.

Blecher–Weaver: singular ctbly-add PURE state on B(ℓ²κ) ⟺ κ Ulam-measurable (arXiv:1607.08505). Cardinal extracted from the diagonal masa ℓ∞(κ); pure≠2-valued; does NOT transfer to concrete (Kochen–Specker, Akemann–Weaver).
Ulam: a 2-valued σ-additive non-principal measure forces a measurable carrier. Matrix breaks at CONSTRUCTION on a σ-class (non-orthogonal unions), not at the contradiction.

open_frontier.name: σ-point-selection core
open_frontier.one_line: Does a finitely-coherent local 2-valued pattern extend to a global NON-Dirac σ-additive 2-valued state on a concrete non-Boolean σ-OML? No prior art on the concrete sector.

open_frontier.name: Large-cardinal bounds
open_frontier.one_line: STRENGTH GENUINELY UNKNOWN (bounds 3f/3i, 2026-06-26/27): LB mechanism REFUTED (Navara-Ptak ZFC non-Dirac state breaks 'no measurable => every state Dirac'; + that premise pushes toward Psi anyway). UB unearned (Levy-Solovay bars forcing; B-W doesn't transfer). RDP-failure is NOT a proved obstruction ((c)-open; E(H) shows broad version false; Harding/Hamhalter confirm untreated). So Psi could be ZFC-decidable or need some cardinal -- no evidence either way. 'measurable' conjecture withdrawn. CBER bridge (last constructive lead) KILLED §3j — same type/strength non-sequitur; no entering tool remains.

open_frontier.name: Intrinsic class 𝒦 (frontier object)
open_frontier.one_line: UNBUILT target carrier: generators ∈ 𝒦, closed under complement + countable disjoint union, forbidden finite intersections (S∩S′)×{0} ∉ 𝒦. Exists ⟺ witness exists. Required profile: non-segregated, off-center, non-Boolean, non-loop, non-band, uncountably generated, globally non-compositional. SHARPENED 2026-06-26 (hybrid analysis, large_cardinal_bounds §3d): the obstruction is irreducibly NON-CENTRAL — neither central (segregated/excluded) nor absent (Gleason/no-obstruction); the strength axis factors out, leaving this as the sole target. See ce.concept.oml_center (the assessed-and-failed center pairing). FRONTIER LOCATED 2026-06-26 (bounds 3g): witness MUST be non-Polish (DW + construction attack, two directions) = the only remaining arena, but it has NO ENTERING TOOL -- hand-construction resists non-standard-Borel, forcing barred, strength unknown. Open question reframed: what object/principle could produce a non-Polish non-standard-Borel concrete sigma-OML with un-threadable gluing? No candidate principle on the table. CONFIRMED irreducibly-non-central by strat.center_hybrid's failure (obstruction can be neither central=segregated nor absent — must live in the irreducible non-central part).
